name: SocialBee
description: SocialBee is a social media management product for creating, scheduling, publishing, recycling, analyzing, and engaging with content across multiple social networks and workspaces.
agentUseSummary: SocialBee is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Its official Help Center explicitly states that SocialBee has no public API and does not support custom n8n-style connections; public API support remains a roadmap item without a timeline.

webhookRequirements: SocialBee can send scheduled posts to a customer-owned outbound posting webhook, but that does not provide inbound account access or a SocialBee API for Relay.

capabilities.label: Manage social content
capabilities.description: After SocialBee publishes or approves an API contract, manage provider-authorized social content, calendars, analytics, and engagement within that contract.

blocked.label: Connect without a SocialBee public API
blocked.description: SocialBee explicitly states that it has no public API, so Relay has no authorized authentication or service contract to implement.

blocked.label: Use private APIs or browser sessions
blocked.description: Relay will not reuse passwords, cookies, browser or mobile sessions, reverse engineer traffic, call undocumented endpoints, or automate the SocialBee interface.

blocked.label: Access SocialBee account or content data
blocked.description: Users, workspaces, profiles, tokens, categories, schedules, posts, media, analytics, comments, DMs, mentions, AI inputs, billing, and exports are unavailable without a public API.

blocked.label: Publish or administer SocialBee
blocked.description: Content creation, scheduling, publishing, engagement, integrations, webhooks, team, workspace, account, subscription, and deletion actions are unavailable without a public API.

approvalProfiles.label: Public API required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until SocialBee publishes or explicitly approves an API contract for Relay.

runtimeSupport.description: SocialBee remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable while the provider has no public API.
SocialBee remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable while the provider has no public API.

providerSetup.blocker: SocialBee's official documentation explicitly says it has no public API, custom connections such as n8n are unsupported, and public API support is only a long-term roadmap item without a timeline. Supported Zapier, Make, Pabbly, and Boost.space integrations do not expose a general SocialBee API or authorize Relay to impersonate those products.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only after SocialBee publishes a public developer programme or gives Relay written integration approval with production API documentation, authentication and credential lifecycle, allowed operations, privacy and social-platform terms, rate limits, test workspace, and live acceptance requirements.

evidence.supports: SocialBee's explicit current statement that it has no public API and invites ideas by email rather than offering developer access.
Supported integrations, explicit lack of direct n8n/custom API connections, and public API support as a roadmap item without a timeline.
Current supported social networks, posting, analytics and engagement product scope, plus the customer-owned outbound posting-webhook feature.
SocialBee's webhook feature is outbound delivery of scheduled posts to a customer URL, not inbound API access to SocialBee data or operations.

securityNotes: Relay does not infer that SocialBee's integrations with social-network APIs, Zapier, Make, Pabbly, Boost.space, or outbound webhooks create a public SocialBee API.
No password, cookie, browser session, mobile session, linked-social token, private endpoint, traffic capture, or undocumented service may be used to connect SocialBee.
All account, workspace, team, profile, token, category, schedule, post, media, analytics, engagement, AI, billing, publishing, integration, webhook, and administration operations remain unavailable.
The Marketplace entry is preview-only and non-installable until SocialBee publishes or approves a complete API and authentication contract.
